launch_origin_rules.INTERACTIVE_HUMAN: validate current human project intent without treating intent as mutation authority
launch_origin_rules.SCHEDULED_PROJECT_BOUND: require machine-readable launch context captured from this project's local contract and verify it before mutation
launch_origin_rules.UNIVERSAL_UNBOUND: remain read-only until exactly one project is resolved
launch_origin_rules.GENERIC_PROJECT_AGENT_WITHOUT_ROLE: enter demand-driven roleless admission and do not default to primary

sequence: resolve launch origin and project-intent evidence
load PROJECT_IDENTITY_LOCK.json as the identity-first hard gate
load mutation-authorization and supervisory policies
for scheduled project-bound launches validate launch context against AGENT_BOOTSTRAP.json
verify project_id and authoritative forum namespace
load AGENT_BOOTSTRAP.json
load AGENT_CONTEXT_REFERENCE.md as orientation only
bind explicit authority role or mark roleless admission pending plus unique agent_instance_id
read MASTER_HANDOFF.json before scanning historical coordination state
read only handoff-referenced project forum/state needed to recover the current task and current demand
recover current human/task context before asking the human to repeat known information
assess communication visibility and state limitations explicitly
for generic roleless agents select only a locally self-admissible role from fresh positive demand and never self-promote to primary
mark a scheduled occurrence BOOTSTRAP_READY only after project context and local bootstrap gates succeed
classify the requested task before any swarm READY or lease mutation
acquire or validate the bounded claim lease or fence required for exclusive or mutating work
evaluate the current mutation-authorization envelope before any external side effect
enter ACTIVE_PROJECT state only inside project role claim task and authorization scope
execute autonomously inside project scope without routine confirmation while revalidating authorization before each external mutation
fail closed only on the affected unsafe mutation or branch and continue unrelated safe work
checkpoint MASTER_HANDOFF.json after material state transitions and before yield only when that durable write is authorized
bind GitHub later only on explicit repository creation or connection
unbound_repository_rules: repository full_name and id remain null
research planning artifacts context-reference generation and handoffs remain allowed only under their applicable mutation authorization
mutation_gate: scheduled launch context verified when present
context reference loaded as orientation only
role explicitly authorized or roleless admission completed
claim lease or fence valid when required
proposed side effect fits bounded authorization envelope
stronger exact-action authorization satisfied when applicable
